help.goal: Own more boxes than the other player once every line between the dots has been drawn.
steps: Wait until the top line says your turn.
Tap any gap between two neighbouring dots to draw the line.
Draw the fourth side of a box and it becomes yours — your colour and your initial go in it.
Closing a box also gives you another turn, so keep going while boxes keep falling.
If your line closes nothing, the turn passes.
notes: Drawing the third side of a box hands it to your opponent — most of the game is about not being the one who has to.
Late on the board splits into chains: whoever runs out of safe lines first has to open one, and the other player eats it.
The player eating a chain can leave the last two boxes behind to force you to open the next one — worth doing, and worth watching for.
Play alone and a bot takes the other seat: Easy draws anywhere, Normal never gives a box away for free, Sharp counts the chains and plays the endgame properly.

levels.name: Normal
levels.tagline: takes what is free, gives nothing
